item.title: Centreville explosion, fire forces families to evacuate from neighborhood
item.description: Dozens of families were evacuated Sunday night after a loud explosion and a house fire rocked a Centreville neighborhood, according to Fairfax County Fire and Rescue.Crews responded around 9:48 p.m. to multiple reports of an explosion and a home fully engulfed in flames in the 14300 block of Quail Pond Court.
